summary: Do not ship this design yet: it preserves two fail-open paths in the mechanism intended to prevent vacuous-green guard runs.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: The migration gate can silently lose kernel consumers
findings.body: T6 stops recognizing direct `SCAN:` producers but never rejects them, while the runtime file roster is derived from the same kernel-call grep as the static roster. Reverting a single-label guard to direct output therefore removes it from both sets; their equality still passes, and the deliberately slack floor permits the loss. A newly added direct producer is likewise invisible. This recreates the exact kernel-bypass drift the design claims to close.
findings.code:
전환 전략은 **양쪽 인식 후 축소**다.

1. 게이트의 정적 grep을 옛 형태(`console.log(\`SCAN:`)와 새 형태(`scanFloor(`·`scanSignal(`) **둘 다**
   인식하도록 확장한다. 이후 각 이행 티켓이 독립적으로 green이다.
2. 소비자를 티켓 단위로 옮긴다.
3. **마지막 티켓에서 옛 형태 인식을 제거한다.**

3번은 선택이 아니라 이행의 일부다. 빠뜨리면 누군가 `console.log(\`SCAN: …\`)`로 되돌아가도 게이트가
통과한다. 커널을 우회하는 문이 열린 채 남는 것이고, 그것은 이 티켓이 없애려는 상태와 같다.

### 함께 손대는 것

- **정적 집합 바닥값**(`[ "$n" -ge 6 ]`, :195)을 새 라벨 수에 맞춰 조정한다. 이 바닥값은 이미 있고
  ("콜사이트가 통째로 사라지면 정적·런타임이 함께 줄어 등식이 유지된다 — 적대 검토가 실측한 구멍"),
  `check-ci-parity` 신호 추가로 라벨 수가 늘어난다. **바닥값은 래칫이 아니므로** 여유를 둔다.
- **`files` 열거**(`grep -lE`, :197)도 같은 패턴 확장이 필요하다. `[ -n "$files" ]`가 뒤를 받친다.
- 이 게이트는 원래 하드코딩 목록(3종)이었는데 실제 방출은 5종이었고 그래서 파생으로 고쳤다
  (:186 주석, "하드코딩 소비처 목록은 자기 자신에게만 정확하다"). **다시 손으로 적지 않는다.**
findings.recommendation: Add a post-migration negative gate that rejects executable direct `SCAN:` producers, discover kernel calls with a format-invariant mechanism such as the TypeScript AST, and use an exact independently checked coverage expectation rather than a floor with headroom.

findings.title: Malformed floor values remain fail-open
findings.body: The API accepts JavaScript `number` values without defining validity constraints, and the design explicitly leaves injection handling unchanged. Two existing consumers use raw `Number(...)`; testing the current tree with `DISK_CAP_MIN_FLAGS=abc` and `--min-scan abc` produced valid SCAN markers and exit 0 because every comparison with `NaN` is false. Migrating that behavior unchanged lets a typo silently disable the enumeration floor—the failure class this kernel is meant to eliminate.
findings.code:
### 임계값은 커널이 모른다

주입 방식이 셋으로 갈린다(상수 `MIN_SCAN=30` · 플래그 `--min-scan` · 환경변수 `DISK_CAP_MIN_FLAGS`).
커널은 **숫자만 받는다**. 셸 커널 주석의 결정을 그대로 물려받는다 — *"바닥값 수치는 소비자가 소유한다.
열거자는 '글롭이 깨져 0건'과 '정당하게 0건'을 구별할 도메인 지식이 없다."* 주입 방식 통일은 이 티켓 밖이다.
findings.recommendation: Make validity part of the kernel contract: reject non-finite, non-safe-integer, or negative `got`/`min` values before comparison, migrate the raw-Number consumers, and test malformed flag and environment inputs.
